# FDG9068

> DO allow the `Dispose(bool)` method to be called more than once. The method might choose to do nothing after the first call.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.4.1 Basic Dispose Pattern.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

## From the book

```csharp
public class DisposableResourceHolder : IDisposable {

   bool _disposed = false;

   protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing) {
      if (_disposed) {
        return;
      }
      // cleanup
      ...
      disposed = true;
   }
}
```
